answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph stops fakes. Each newcomer posts a 40-token bond naming its sponsor, so each identity is a tree in a grove. Peers may dispute any identity, which must show real trades in 10 epochs or lose its bond; a failing sponsor pays the penalty. 100 fakes cost 4,000 tokens. A hollow shell is exposed by its star referrals. An honest agent pays one bond and earns undiluted rewards, its sonnet-strict record proves it real.
